subject: general
question: Which of the following companies launched India’s first hydrogen fuel cell-powered electric car in March 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Toyota Kirloskar Motor Private Limited**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Toyota Kirloskar Motor Private Limited** launched India’s first hydrogen fuel cell-powered electric car in March 2022

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• This **innovative vehicle runs on hydrogen fuel cells**, producing zero tailpipe emissions, with water being the only by-product
 
• The Toyota Mirai boasts an **impressive range of around 640 km **on a single refill, and its hydrogen tank can be topped up quickly
 
• The** launch was inaugurated by Union Minister for Road Transport and Highways, Nitin Gadkari**,
 
 
• who emphasized the importance of transitioning to clean energy and reducing dependence on fossil fuels 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Hydrogen Fuel Cell Technology **generates electricity by combining hydrogen with oxygen.**
 
• **Benefits of Hydrogen fuel-** 
 
 
• Zero emissions (only water vapour and heat)
 
• Energy efficiency
 
• Reduced greenhouse gas emissions
 
• Improved air quality
